statements.statement: The service was denied with reason code CO-197
The procedure code billed was CPT 93229
The patient presented with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There was concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The patient had a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture the underlying rhythm during symptomatic events
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic triggers contributing to the cerebrovascular symptoms
Required prior authorization was not obtained
The diagnosis codes submitted were I47.1 and G45.9
